summary: Backend: 17/17 NEW iteration-2 pytest tests PASS (categories CRUD + case-insensitive idempotent POST, tags case-insensitive idempotent, dealers CRUD, agents add/remove/set-current with started_at/ended_at semantics, tool round-trip with category/dealer/agent/warranty/consumable, GET /api/tools filters category_id/dealer_id/is_consumable, /api/aggregate full shape + filters, /api/stats new fields incl. warranty_expiring_soon/warranty_expired, /api/warranty-alerts splits expiring vs expired correctly, toolbox-layouts CRUD, /api/toolbox/analyze returned valid Gemini 2.5 Pro shape {suggested_drawers,labels,confidence,notes} on a real photographed JPEG). Combined with iteration-1 regression: 28/28 unique tests pass on a fresh run; AI test failed once on rerun with 500 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.00434875, Max budget: 0.001' from Emergent LLM key — the endpoint and code are correct, this is an account-level budget cap. No _id leaks anywhere (verified by recursive walker on every response). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): all 5 tabs (tab-inventory/dealers/people/reports/more) present with proper testIDs; Inventory shows 4 filter chips (filter-all/available/out/consumables) + summary-header + tool-card-{id} + add-tool-fab; Dealers tab lists dealer-card-{id} cards with name/tools/spent/agents summary; tap into a dealer-card opens detail page that shows Tools/Spent/Categories/Tags/Agents summary cells, CURRENT AGENT box, ALL AGENTS section with add-agent-btn, and 'Tools purchased from {dealer}' section; Reports tab has toggle-include-photos and report-full/out/in-btn; More tab shows more-categories/tags/locations/toolbox/warranty navigation links and toggle-prices/toggle-summary/toggle-warranty-alerts; /manage/categories renders manage-name-input + manage-add-btn + del-{id}; /warranty renders EXPIRED and EXPIRING SOON sections; /toolbox renders empty state with new-toolbox-btn / ADD PHOTO; Add Tool screen exposes name-input, cost-input, cat-input + cat-suggest-{id} (autocomplete), tag-input, pick-loc-{id}, pick-dealer-btn, toggle-consumable, toggle-warranty, add-photo-camera/gallery-btn, add-doc-btn — all iteration-2 fields are present.

minor.issue: Emergent LLM key budget exceeded after a few calls (500 with 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.00434875, Max budget: 0.001'). Endpoint code is correct, this is an account/key-side cap that needs to be raised.

ui_bugs.component: app/(tabs)/reports.tsx — 'Include photos in PDF' toggle row
ui_bugs.issue: The yellow image icon and the label 'Include photos in PDF' visually overlap on a 390px wide screen: the icon is rendered on top of the first character(s) of the label so the row reads as a hidden/clipped label with only 'Off' + the toggle clearly visible. The toggle (toggle-include-photos) still works.

issues: Console still emits deprecation warnings: shadow* style props (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking on web.

action_items: Fix the Reports tab 'Include photos in PDF' row: the leading photo icon and the label text overlap on narrow screens — either give the icon its own flex slot with marginRight, or wrap label in flex:1.

Raise / refresh the Emergent LLM key budget — the AI toolbox analyze endpoint is functionally correct but the key exhausts its $0.001 budget after a couple of Gemini 2.5 Pro vision calls. Without a higher cap, the AI feature will return 500 in real use after a few invocations.
(Optional) Migrate deprecated shadow* and pointerEvents props to silence RN web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 843 lines — still readable but starts to push the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting routers by resource (tools/dealers/categories/toolbox) into a routers/ package next iteration.
All Mongo reads use {"_id": 0} projection AND Pydantic re-serialization, so _id leak risk is solid. Verified recursively in tests.
POST /api/categories and POST /api/tags use case-insensitive regex with re.escape — correct and idempotent.

Dealers agent flow correctly auto-promotes the first added agent to current_agent_id, falls back to remaining[0] when the current is removed, and stamps started_at/ended_at on current-agent transitions.
Aggregate endpoint applies the same build_tool_query as list_tools (good DRY) and never sums None costs (uses (i.get('cost') or 0)).
Warranty-alerts uses string-based date comparisons; OK because dates are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' but skips tools with empty expiry_date — correct.

AI analyze endpoint validates EMERGENT_LLM_KEY presence (returns 500), strips data: prefix, strips ```json fences, falls back to regex JSON extraction, clamps suggested_drawers to 0..40 and pads/truncates labels to match — robust.
Tool checkout/checkin still uses read-modify-write list mutation (not $push). Acceptable for single-user app, flagged previously.

success_rate.backend: 100% on first run (17/17 new + 11/11 regression = 28/28); AI test fails on subsequent runs only because of Emergent LLM budget cap, not code

rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found in iteration-2 backend. The single AI analyze 500 on rerun was traced to the Emergent LLM key returning litellm.BadRequestError 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.00434875, Max budget: 0.001' — i.e. account-side budget cap, not the FastAPI code. Mitigation: raise EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget.
